title: Daily digest: Telangana: Home guard killed by husband  | Bihar MLA Anant Singh gifts Rs 3-crore D | State govt. employees who donate organs
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / India Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Telangana: Home guard killed by husband after 14 yrs of marriage.
Bihar MLA Anant Singh gifts Rs 3-crore Defender to son-in-law, BMW for son.
State govt. employees who donate organs likely to get leave for recuperation.
bullets_ur: Home guard ki maut ho gayi.
Bihar ke MLA Anant Singh ne damad ko 3 crore ki Defender aur bete ko BMW tohfay mein di.
Organ donate karne wale state govt. employees ko sehatyabi ke liye chhutti milne ka imkaan.
